UNGRADABLE ORACLE_REFUSES: fpc 3.2.2 -Miso never finishes compiling this ISO 7185 acceptance program: ppcx64 spins at 100% CPU with no diagnostic (measured >300s; line 1 warning "Unsupported switch" is the only output). Bisected to line 77 `label 0, 3, 9999, 0004;` -- a three-line program declaring `label 0;` reproduces the spin under -Miso and -Mextendedpascal, while labels 1, 01, 0004 and 9999 compile; -Mfpc and -Mtp instead reject the program at line 114.
